notes:
• My numbers now follows the week you click in My time, so you can see your numbers for any earlier week.
• A week gets a utilization number once it's in, which means 90% of its hours are booked or it's more than four weeks old.
• Until a week is in, it says "in progress" or "incomplete" instead of a percentage.
• Unbooked time is its own number now: it adds up the hours missing from the last four weeks and gets redder as it grows.
• Time booked to Stenhouse Consulting counts as not billable, and UTO is treated as time off like PTO.
• For managers: Team's PTO left column no longer changes between loads.
